login.title: Sign in to the panel
login.hint: The password is stored in webui.password in the configuration file. It is generated on first start and printed to the console.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: Bot status and the state of each connection, refreshed every 5 seconds.
dashboard.unconfigured_hint: AppID and AppSecret are not set. Fill them in on the Settings page and restart to bring the bot online.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Messages received and sent through CatOfficial. This is also the index for quoted replies and get_msg. Retention is set in Settings.

bindings.title: Identity bindings
bindings.description: Bind an OpenID of the official bot back to its original QQ or group number, so data your OneBot app keeps by number carries over.
bindings.name: Name
bindings.unbind_confirm: After unbinding, {{number}} returns to the number assigned by CatOfficial. Continue?
bindings.form_hint: Enter the number CatOfficial currently assigns, or the OpenID.
bindings.qq_hint: The original QQ or group number

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Changes are written to the configuration file and take effect after a restart.
settings.app_secret_keep: Already set. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.subscribe_hint: Requires the matching permission, otherwise the platform rejects the connection.
settings.auto_ack_hint: Responds to button clicks immediately so the user's client does not keep spinning.
settings.webhook_hint: Used only when events are delivered by webhook. The callback needs a public HTTPS address, usually behind a reverse proxy.
settings.access_token_hint: Apps must send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Leave empty to disable the check.
settings.new_password_hint: Leave empty to keep it. At least 6 characters.
settings.public_warning: Listening on 0.0.0.0 makes this reachable from other machines. Make sure an access token or a strong panel password is set.

about.title: About
about.description: A relay that turns the QQ official bot into a standard OneBot V11 implementation.
